Test_Description: Tests CSI-2 data reception across varying DPHY lane configurations (4-lane down to 1-lane). Validates interrupt enable, PHY initialization, stop-state detection, lane reconfiguration, DMA control/data packet transfers, and IRQ-based completion polling for each lane count.
Step_Description: Enable CSI-2 Interrupts - Read INT_ST_MAIN to clear pending interrupts
Register_Description: Main interrupt status register. Reading clears pending interrupts.
Comments: Read to clear all pending interrupt status bits

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_PHY_FATAL to enable PHY fatal interrupts
Register_Description: Mask register for PHY fatal interrupts. Enables SOT sync error reporting on all 4 data lanes.
Comments: Enable phy_errsotsynchs interrupts for lanes 0-3

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_PKT_FATAL to enable packet fatal interrupts
Register_Description: Mask register for packet fatal interrupts. Enables ECC double-bit error and shorter payload detection.
Comments: Enable ECC double error and shorter payload interrupts

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_PHY to enable PHY interrupts
Register_Description: Mask register for PHY interrupts. Enables SOT HS error and escape entry error on all 4 lanes.
Comments: Enable SOT HS errors (bits 3:0) and escape errors (bits 19:16)

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_LINE to enable line interrupts
Register_Description: Mask register for line interrupts. Enables line boundary match and line sequence errors.
Comments: Enable line boundary and sequence error interrupts

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_BNDRY_FRAME_FATAL to enable boundary frame fatal interrupts
Register_Description: Mask register for boundary frame fatal interrupts. Enables frame start/end mismatch detection on all VCs.
Comments: Enable frame boundary match errors for all 16 virtual channels

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_SEQ_FRAME_FATAL to enable sequence frame fatal interrupts
Register_Description: Mask register for sequence frame fatal interrupts. Enables incorrect frame sequence detection on all VCs.
Comments: Enable frame sequence error interrupts for all 16 virtual channels

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_CRC_FRAME_FATAL to enable CRC frame fatal interrupts
Register_Description: Mask register for CRC frame fatal interrupts. Enables CRC error detection per frame per VC.
Comments: Enable CRC frame fatal interrupts for all 16 virtual channels

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_PLD_CRC_FATAL to enable payload CRC fatal interrupts
Register_Description: Mask register for payload CRC fatal interrupts. Enables payload checksum error detection on all VCs.
Comments: Enable payload CRC fatal interrupts for all 16 virtual channels

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_DATA_ID to enable data ID interrupts
Register_Description: Mask register for data ID interrupts. Enables unrecognized data type detection on all VCs.
Comments: Enable data ID error interrupts for all 16 virtual channels

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_ECC_CORRECTED to enable ECC corrected interrupts
Register_Description: Mask register for ECC corrected interrupts. Enables header ECC correction detection on all VCs.
Comments: Enable ECC corrected interrupts for all 16 virtual channels

Step_Description: Write CSI-2 subsystem virtual channel register
Register_Description: CSI-2 subsystem virtual channel mapping register. Maps VC IDs to GDMA paths.
Comments: Configure virtual channel ID mapping based on selected GDMA path

Step_Description: Enable control data transfer in subsystem
Register_Description: Control data enable register. Enables control data path transfer.
Comments: Enable control data transfer path

Step_Description: D-PHY initialization sequence (snps_phy_init)
Register_Description: Performs SNPS D-PHY initialization sequence including PHY shutdown/reset/test control.
Comments: Calls PHY init routine - configures PHY_SHUTDOWNZ (0x40) / DPHY_RSTZ (0x44) / PHY_TEST_CTRL0 (0x50) / PHY_TEST_CTRL1 (0x54)

Step_Description: Poll PHY_STOPSTATE register until all lanes and clock in stop state
Register_Description: PHY stop state status register. Indicates data lanes 0-3 and clock lane are in stop state.
Comments: Poll until rd_data == 0x1000F (all 4 data lanes + clock lane in stop state)

Step_Description: Loop: Configure N_LANES register for lane_num (3 down to 0)
Register_Description: Number of active data lanes configuration. Can only be updated when PHY lane is in stopstate.
Comments: Iterates from 4 lanes (n_lanes=3) down to 1 lane (n_lanes=0). Tests each lane configuration.

Step_Description: Write trigger register to start CSI-2 sequence with (lane_num+1) lanes
Register_Description: External trigger register. Writing lane count triggers CSI-2 transmit sequence.
Comments: Triggers CSI-2 sequence for the configured number of lanes

Step_Description: Enable DMA IRQ[1] and IRQ[0] via DMA INTEN register
Register_Description: DMA interrupt enable register. Enables DMA IRQ channel 0 and channel 1.
Comments: Enable dma_irq[0] and dma_irq[1]

Step_Description: Preload DMA CH0 transfer instructions for control data (src=0x8000, dst=0xE6001000, size=8)
Register_Description: Programs DMA channel 0 with transfer instructions for control packet reception.
Comments: DMA CH0: src=0x8000, dest=0xE6001000, transfer_size=8 bytes, irq_num=0

Step_Description: Issue DMAGO command for CH0 to start control data DMA transfer
Register_Description: Issues DMAGO instruction via debug registers (DBGINST0/DBGINST1/DBGCMD) to start DMA channel 0.
Comments: Starts DMA CH0 transfer for control packet

Step_Description: Poll DMA INTMIS register for IRQ[0] completion (control packet)
Register_Description: DMA masked interrupt status register. Indicates DMA transfer completion.
Comments: Poll until (rd_data & 0x1) != 0, indicating CH0 transfer complete

Step_Description: Clear DMA IRQ[0] via INTCLR register
Register_Description: DMA interrupt clear register. Clears the specified DMA IRQ.
Comments: Clear dma_irq[0] after control packet transfer completion

Step_Description: Read control data from memory (0xE6001000) and check data type
Register_Description: Memory-mapped location where DMA deposited the CSI-2 control packet header.
Comments: Extract data_type (bits 5:0) and word_count (bits 21:6) from control packet

Step_Description: If data_type > 0xF (long packet): Preload DMA CH1 for CSI data transfer
Register_Description: Programs DMA channel 1 for CSI-2 image/video data transfer based on word_count.
Comments: DMA CH1: src=0x0000, dest=0xE6002000, transfer_size=csi_data_size (8-byte aligned word_count), irq_num=1

Step_Description: Issue DMAGO command for CH1 to start CSI data DMA transfer
Register_Description: Issues DMAGO instruction to start DMA channel 1 for CSI data.
Comments: Starts DMA CH1 transfer for CSI image data

Step_Description: Poll DMA INTMIS register for IRQ[1] completion (CSI data)
Register_Description: DMA masked interrupt status register. Indicates DMA CH1 transfer completion.
Comments: Poll until (rd_data & 0x2) != 0, indicating CH1 transfer complete

Step_Description: Clear DMA IRQ[1] via INTCLR register
Register_Description: DMA interrupt clear register. Clears DMA IRQ channel 1.
Comments: Clear dma_irq[1] after CSI data transfer completion

Step_Description: Repeat steps 18-27 for all control/data packets in current lane config, then decrement lane_num and repeat steps 16-27
Register_Description: Outer loop: lane_num from 3 to 0. Inner loop: cntrl_pkt_cnt = (VRES*3)+2 packets per lane config.
Comments: Total iterations: 4 lane configs x ((VRES*3)+2) packets each. VRES=3 (default), so 11 packets per lane config.

Step_Description: Call finish(0) to end test
Register_Description: Test completion function. Argument 0 indicates pass.
Comments: Test passes if all lane configurations complete DMA transfers successfully

Test_Description: Tests CSI-2 internal pattern generator (PG) functionality. Configures PG with specific resolution/data-type/VC, programs DMA for data reception, enables PG, waits for transfer completion via DMA IRQ polling, then disables PG.
Step_Description: Enable CSI-2 Interrupts - Read INT_ST_MAIN to clear pending interrupts
Register_Description: Main interrupt status register. Reading clears pending interrupts.
Comments: Read to clear all pending interrupt status bits

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_PHY_FATAL to enable PHY fatal interrupts
Register_Description: Mask register for PHY fatal interrupts.
Comments: Enable PHY fatal interrupts for all 4 lanes

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_PKT_FATAL to enable packet fatal interrupts
Register_Description: Mask register for packet fatal interrupts.
Comments: Enable ECC double error and shorter payload interrupts

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_PHY to enable PHY interrupts
Register_Description: Mask register for PHY interrupts.
Comments: Enable SOT HS and escape entry error interrupts

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_LINE to enable line interrupts
Register_Description: Mask register for line interrupts.
Comments: Enable line boundary and sequence error interrupts

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_BNDRY_FRAME_FATAL
Register_Description: Mask register for boundary frame fatal interrupts.
Comments: Enable frame boundary match error interrupts

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_SEQ_FRAME_FATAL
Register_Description: Mask register for sequence frame fatal interrupts.
Comments: Enable frame sequence error interrupts

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_CRC_FRAME_FATAL
Register_Description: Mask register for CRC frame fatal interrupts.
Comments: Enable CRC frame fatal interrupts

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_PLD_CRC_FATAL
Register_Description: Mask register for payload CRC fatal interrupts.
Comments: Enable payload CRC fatal interrupts

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_DATA_ID
Register_Description: Mask register for data ID interrupts.
Comments: Enable data ID error interrupts

Step_Description: Write INT_MSK_ECC_CORRECTED
Register_Description: Mask register for ECC corrected interrupts.
Comments: Enable ECC corrected interrupts

Step_Description: Write CSI-2 subsystem virtual channel register
Register_Description: CSI-2 subsystem virtual channel mapping register.
Comments: Configure VC mapping: selected VC=3 on chosen GDMA path, unselected VC=4 on other paths

Step_Description: Disable control data transfer in subsystem
Register_Description: Control data enable register. Disables control data path (PG test uses data path only).
Comments: Disable control data transfer for pattern generator test

Step_Description: Enable CSI-2 and DMA subsystem interrupts
Register_Description: Enables subsystem-level interrupts for CSI-2 and DMA.
Comments: Configures interrupt_enable (0x1C) and fifo_interrupt_enable (0x2C) registers

Step_Description: D-PHY initialization sequence
Register_Description: Performs SNPS D-PHY initialization.
Comments: Configures PHY_SHUTDOWNZ / DPHY_RSTZ / PHY_TEST_CTRL0 / PHY_TEST_CTRL1

Step_Description: Poll PHY_STOPSTATE until all lanes and clock in stop state
Register_Description: PHY stop state status register.
Comments: Poll until rd_data == 0x1000F

Step_Description: Program DMA higher-order address bits for AR CH0 Data
Register_Description: DMA AXI read address MSB for channel 0 data path.
Comments: Set upper address bits for DMA read channel 0 data

Step_Description: Program DMA higher-order address bits for AR CH0 Instruction
Register_Description: DMA AXI read address MSB for channel 0 instruction path.
Comments: Set upper address bits for DMA read channel 0 instruction

Step_Description: Program DMA higher-order address bits for AW CH0 Data
Register_Description: DMA AXI write address MSB for channel 0 data path.
Comments: Set upper address bits for DMA write channel 0 data

Step_Description: Program DMA higher-order address bits for AW CH0 Instruction
Register_Description: DMA AXI write address MSB for channel 0 instruction path.
Comments: Set upper address bits for DMA write channel 0 instruction

Step_Description: Enable fracdiv output to CSI-2 subsystem
Register_Description: Enable sending fracdiv output to CSI-2 subsystem.
Comments: Enable fractional divider clock output

Step_Description: Preload DMA CH0 transfer instructions (src=0x00, dst=0xE6001000, size=csi2_data_trnsfr_size)
Register_Description: Programs DMA channel 0 with transfer instructions for PG data reception. Transfer size = ((24*320/8) aligned to 8) * 16 = 960 * 16 = 15360 bytes.
Comments: DMA CH0: src=0x00, dest=0xE6001000, size=15360 bytes, src_incr=0, dest_incr=1, irq_num=0

Step_Description: Issue DMAGO command for CH0
Register_Description: Issues DMAGO instruction to start DMA channel 0.
Comments: Start DMA CH0 transfer for pattern generator data

Step_Description: Configure PG vertical resolution (VRES=16)
Register_Description: PPI Pattern Generator vertical resolution register. Sets number of lines.
Comments: Set PG vertical resolution to 16 lines

Step_Description: Configure PG horizontal resolution (HRES=320, pkt2pkt_time=7)
Register_Description: PPI Pattern Generator horizontal resolution and packet-to-packet time register.
Comments: Set PG HRES=320 (bits 15:0=0x140), pkt2pkt_time=7 (bits 25:16=0x7)

Step_Description: Configure PG config (pattern=1, datatype=0x24/RGB888, vc=3)
Register_Description: PPI Pattern Generator configuration register. Sets pattern type, data type, and virtual channel.
Comments: pattern=1 (bit 0), datatype=0x24/RGB888 (bits 13:8), vc=3 (bits 15:14)

Step_Description: Enable Pattern Generator
Register_Description: PPI Pattern Generator enable register. Starts pattern generation.
Comments: Enable the internal pattern generator

Step_Description: Wait 100 cycles for PG data generation
Register_Description: Software delay to allow pattern generator to produce data.
Comments: Wait for pattern data to be generated and transferred

Step_Description: Disable Pattern Generator
Register_Description: PPI Pattern Generator enable register. Stops pattern generation.
Comments: Disable the internal pattern generator after data generation

Step_Description: Poll DMA INTMIS register for IRQ[0] completion
Register_Description: DMA masked interrupt status register.
Comments: Poll until (rd_data & 0x1) != 0, indicating DMA CH0 transfer complete

Step_Description: Wait 10000 cycles for completion
Register_Description: Software delay for final stabilization.
Comments: Wait for all operations to complete

Step_Description: Call finish(0) to end test
Register_Description: Test completion function. Argument 0 indicates pass.
Comments: Test passes if PG data is successfully received via DMA
